content.title: 76ers vs. Nuggets Prediction, Spread, NBA Picks for Tuesday, March 17
content.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (37-31) head to Ball Arena to clash with the powerhouse Denver Nuggets (41-27) on Tuesday at 10:00 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock.Philadelphia is on a two-game winning streak, and Denver is likely motivated to bounce back from a tight overtime loss vs. the Lakers on March 14.Below, we’ll break down our 76ers vs. Nuggets prediction and picks for Tuesday night’s game. Its rotation is depleted without the MVP-level production of C Joel Embiid and the dynamic scoring of PG Tyrese Maxey; both are currently sidelined with injuries. The battered 76ers roster is in serious need of secondary playmakers stepping into the spotlight.Despite missing their two biggest stars, the 76ers have won three out of their last four games. This gritty stretch has been built on the back of 76ers G Quentin Grimes, who has drastically ramped up his offensive output to 23.2 PPG over his last six games.The Denver Nuggets (41-27) sit near the top of the Western Conference and boast the highest-scoring offense in the NBA (120.7 PPG), relying on the elite playmaking of Nuggets C Nikola Jokic and PG Jamal Murray.76ers vs. Nuggets Over/Under, The 76ers will face a much steeper climb without stars Embiid and Maxey for this road rematch vs. a healthy Denver squad.76ers vs. Nuggets Picks for PrizePicks Today: 3/17/26Here are two top 76ers vs. Nuggets picks to target for Tuesday, March 17, on PrizePicks.
